Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran Resigns Amid Succession Row

Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran has resigned from his position. The resignation comes ahead of the company's Annual General Meeting (AGM) on August 18. Reports suggest the resignation is linked to a succession row and tensions with the controlling charity arm of Tata Group. Following the announcement, shares of Tata Group companies, including TCS, experienced a significant decline.
